method.fixtures: Fixed fictional small/heavy structure; generated UUIDs and timestamps retained, explaining small reference-token variation between processes.
method.processes: Three independent before/after pairs, sequential on the same local host with browser tests stopped; each workflow 3 warmups and 15 samples.
method.startup: Each independent task includes initialize instructions, tools/list, operation index, full skill and operation contract once. Handoff includes the required file/evidence follow-up.
method.wire: Actual in-memory JSON-RPC message objects captured and serialized as NDJSON; not physical network packets.
method.tokens: Optional pinned tiktoken 0.12.0/o200k_base reference encoding installed outside the repository; no runtime dependency.
method.limits: Actual Codex model injection and account billing are not observable. No claim of universal latency or task-answer accuracy; selected-value deep equality and source/safety-state preservation are covered by tests.

recommendation: Keep legacy full as default. Small handoffs gain little after startup and increase result-only cost; use full. Heavy completion and targeted evidence reads benefit from opt-in projection.

profilerBaseline.limits: Local baseline samples identify candidates, not percentages of total CPU or proof of after speed.

integratedReleaseTrials.baseline: Native diagram build based on cba32b1; application 1.4.0, schema 30.
integratedReleaseTrials.after: Projection source 2317931 plus both plugin manifests/application 1.5.0; schema 30. Version edits uncommitted during build, runtime source identical.
integratedReleaseTrials.method: Three sequential independent before/after pairs, 3 warmups and 15 samples each workflow; no simultaneous browser/build/test process. Original pre-integration trials retained above.
